worldcombat.skill.waterfall.summary: A water column surges straight up from the feet and lifts the body, then it drives forward and upward in a waterfall-climbing strike: on contact the curtain splashes up, shoving the target back and maybe flinching it; a ceiling lowers the column, and in the rain the water is stronger.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.use.0: Rise against the flow and pounce on a foe a step higher or in low air
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.use.1: Flinch a target to open a damage window for allies
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.use.2: Pounce in the rain for a stronger surge
The column lifts the body up to %5$s blocks by the actual headroom; it then advances %2$s blocks along the aim at %3$s per tick with a %4$s block radius, dealing about %1$s contact damage on a hit.

On a hit the target is shoved %1$s blocks along the pounce and has a %2$s chance to be flinched for %3$s; while flinched it cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks, and the hit interrupts whatever interruptible action it is performing.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.torrent.on: Torrent form: pounces farther and heavier, flinches longer and rises higher, but moves slower and takes a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.torrent.off: Rapid form: shorter, faster pounces with a shorter wind-up, recovery and cooldown, at the cost of a lighter blow and a shorter flinch.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.growth.0: From level %1$s the crash power rises to %2$s and the pounce to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.growth.1: From level %1$s the crash power rises to %2$s, the pounce to %3$s blocks, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.preference.t: On: rises higher, pounce distance ×1.1, power ×1.08, flinch chance ×1.15 and a longer flinch, but pounce speed ×0.92 and +2 wind-up, +2 recovery, +7 cooldown. Off (rapid): shorter, faster pounces with a smoother cycle, at the cost of a lighter blow and a shorter flinch.
worldcombat.skill.waterfall.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts sooner, and is easier to whiff.
On: targets already carrying the shared flinch identity rank lower, saving the pounce for a foe that can still act; off: all targets score the same.
On: targets on a ledge or in low air rank first, where the rising pounce can reach; flat targets are unaffected and are still reached by the same rise. Off: all targets score the same.
The column first lifts the body by the actual headroom, then it pounces forward and upward; it only hits the first enemy it touches, and if it misses or terrain stops it the body falls back to the actual ground and the curtain closes without catching anyone else.
In rain the water swells: this pounce's power and flinch chance both rise.
